prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
finish, new_flow changes can be helpful, delivering 5 wins (+10.6%, +7.0%, +3.6%, +2.9%, +2.2%), though 10 tests showed no clear effect.
home, wait_info changes are helpful, delivering 6 wins (+4.0%, +3.0%, +2.7%, +1.7%, +1.7%, +2.2%), though 9 tests showed no clear effect.
sign_in, reorder is high-risk with 1 major win (+11.9%) and 2 severe losses (-7.0%, -7.4%).
sign_in, layout; adoption, redesign; choose_path, new_screen; home, notification; adoption, copy; adoption, layout; and sign_in, hint consistently failed to yield any wins.
Single-test kinds (such as adoption, new_flow; adoption, wait_info; choose_path, hint; choose_path, layout; choose_path, reorder; sign_in, copy; and sign_in, new_flow) still have thin evidence.
Predictions consistently overestimate weak or failing changes while underestimating major unexpected wins.

Changes:
0: [finish, new_flow] Desktop Companion Quick Control Onboarding Flow: Adds an interactive guided walkthrough step after completion to guide users through summoning, moving, and hiding their desktop companion. (why: 3 support emails reported confusion on how to control or hide the pet after onboarding, and finish step new_flow changes have historically delivered large conversion wins (+10.6%).)
1: [home, wait_info] Pet Render Detailed Processing Timer: Displays an explicit live countdown timer and rendering status breakdown on the generation wait screen. (why: The waiting stage has a long mean completion time (2336s), and wait_info additions on the home step consistently yield positive conversion gains.)
2: [adoption, new_screen] Pet Visual Verification Confirmation Screen: Inserts a dedicated visual verification screen immediately after photo upload to review custom pet features before issuing the certificate. (why: 3 support emails cited custom pet rendering or appearance failures, and adoption has the lowest step conversion rate (71.8%).)
3: [sign_in, new_flow] Account Companion Sync Verification Flow: Adds an automated pet check during sign-in that detects previous companion saves and confirms cloud pet retrieval. (why: 8 support tickets (the largest theme) reported missing or reset pets after signing back in.)
4: [home, wait_info] Desktop Companion Hardware Preparation Status: Adds a stage-based progress tracker and readiness notification toggle while the desktop pet environment loads. (why: Home wait time exhibits high variance (median 201s, mean 2336s), and detailed waiting info updates reliably improve progression.)
5: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Pet Key Command Practice Screen: Adds a dedicated practice screen at the end of onboarding for users to test hotkeys for summoning and hiding their desktop pet. (why: Multiple users reported post-onboarding confusion regarding pet visibility controls, and finish new screens historically perform well.)
6: [sign_in, notification] Existing Pet Account Sync Notification: Adds an explicit banner notification on the sign-in screen reassuring users that logging in restores previously created pets. (why: Directly targets the top support theme (8 emails regarding reset or missing pets after sign-in).)
